refinements.description:
装备者的[强化特殊技]、[连携技]和[终结技]造成的失衡值提升28%；
发动[连携技]或[终结技]并造成火属性伤害时，全队角色造成伤害提升10%，最多叠加2层，持续30秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间，同一招式内最多触发一次，该效果全队唯一。
refinements.descriptionEn:
The Daze dealt by the equipper's EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, and Ultimate increases by 28%.
When using a Chain Attack or Ultimate to deal Fire DMG, the DMG dealt by all squad members increases by 10%, stacking up to 2 times and lasting 30s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Triggers once per use of a skill. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

basic.name: 普通攻击：恶虎七式·燎身爪
basic.nameEn: Basic Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Flaming Claw
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的斩击，造成物理伤害和火属性伤害；
第三段攻击期间，连续点按 【普通攻击键】 可以维持连击，持续打击敌人；
第三段攻击期间，长按或停顿后点按 【普通攻击键】 ，将衔接第四段攻击；
第三段攻击期间抗打断等级提升，受到伤害降低40%。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Slash forward up to four times, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to maintain the combo and keep striking the enemy.
During the 3rd hit, hold or pause before pressing [Basic Attack] to chain into the 4th hit.
During the 3rd hit, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG received is reduced by 40%.

special.name: 特殊技：恶虎七式·下山虎
special.nameEn: Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行旋转斩击后发动下落斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash forward, followed by a falling slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：恶虎七式改·下山猛虎
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
挥舞「虎威」向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动时获得3点[威势]和80点[威风]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Swing Hu Wei forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of Momentum and 80 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform multiple slashes on enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：虎釜崩
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
挥舞「虎威」对前方小范围敌人进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Swing Hu Wei to deliver a powerful strike to enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：恶虎七式·猛虎炸开花
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用「虎威」进行两次下落攻击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动时获得6点[威势]和100点[威风]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 6 points of Momentum and 100 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

quickAssist.descriptionEn:

Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：岿然虎踞
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：彪形焰颌
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:

发动时获得1点[威势]，10秒内最多获得1次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:

Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
橘福福未使用「虎威」时，「虎威」会自动攻击敌人，并在命中敌人时获得[威风]；
「虎威」命中敌人时，若拥有至少100点[威风]且橘福福不为当前操作中角色，橘福福会围绕目标敌人，发动[连携技：虎釜震煞]；发动时，全队角色获得[虎啸]效果：暴击伤害提升20%，橘福福的初始攻击力大于等于2800点时，每超过100点攻击力会使暴击伤害额外提升5%，最多额外提升30%；
[虎啸]状态下，角色的[连携技]/[终结技]造成的伤害提升20%/40%；
[虎啸]状态持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，橘福福处于[虎啸]效果中，冲击力提升50点。
facts.textEn:
When Ju Fufu has yet to use Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain Might upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 Might, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the Tiger's Roar effect: CRIT DMG increases by 20%, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the Tiger's Roar state, character Chain Attack/Ultimate DMG increases by 20%/40%.
The Tiger's Roar state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, Impact increases by 50.

cinema.name: 超级可怕小老虎
cinema.description: 进入战场时，橘福福的暴击率提升12%，立即获得100点[威风]；橘福福的[连携技]命中敌人时，目标处于失衡状态下时，失衡易伤倍率提升35%，持续30秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering combat, Ju Fufu's CRIT Rate increases by 12%, and she immediately gains 100 Might. When Ju Fufu's Chain Attack hits an enemy, when the target is Stunned, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 35%, lasting for 30s.

cinema.name: 神通广大青溟客
cinema.description: 处于[虎啸]状态下角色的暴击伤害额外提升22%；任意角色发动[终结技]时，橘福福回复3点[威势]。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Tiger's Roar state, character CRIT DMG increases by an additional 22%. Whenever any character activates an Ultimate, Ju Fufu gains 3 points of Momentum.

cinema.name: 仗义行侠少年郎
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 降妖伏魔虎修者
cinema.description: 橘福福处于[虎啸]状态下时，自身的暴击伤害提升35%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, her CRIT DMG increases by 35%.

cinema.name: 神威盖世大师姐
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 知我心中虎啸声
cinema.description: 橘福福的[连携技]造成的伤害提升30%；橘福福在高速旋转状态下时，消耗[威势]命中敌人时，会发射3个爆米花，每个爆米花造成福福攻击力160%的伤害，且造成的伤害视为[连携技]伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: Ju Fufu's Chain Attack DMG increases by 30%. Upon consuming Momentum and hitting an enemy in the high-speed spinning state, fire 3 popcorns, each dealing 160% of Fufu's ATK as DMG. This DMG is treated as Chain Attack DMG.

basic.description:
闪避时，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前发动快速斩击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a quick slash forward, dealing Physical DMG.

basic.name: 冲刺攻击：恶虎七式·山君鼎戏
basic.nameEn: Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain King's Game
basic.description:
[冲刺攻击：恶虎七式·虎奔]发动后，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
进入高速旋转状态，该状态下可以拖曳摇杆进行移动，接触敌人时造成物理伤害；
橘福福通过其他招式获得[威势]后，会在高速旋转状态下带有火焰；接触敌人时消耗1点[威势]，改为造成火属性伤害并获得25点[威风]，[威势]上限为15点；
橘福福消耗[威势]造成火属性伤害时，若[威风]高于100点，会自动消耗100点[威风]发动[连携技：虎釜震煞]；
松开 【普通攻击键】 可退出旋转状态，并丢出「虎威」攻击敌人，造成火属性伤害；切换至其他角色时，橘福福会继续处于旋转状态，尝试撞击最近的敌人；
橘福福为当前操作中角色时，招式发动期间受到伤害降低40%，抗打断等级提升，不为当前操作中角色时，获得无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
After using Dash Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Tiger Charge, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Enter a high-speed spinning state. While in this state, use the joystick to move and deal Physical DMG upon contact with enemies.
After Ju Fufu gains Momentum from other skills, she will be surrounded by flames in the high-speed spinning state. Upon contact with enemies, 1 point of Momentum is consumed, changing the DMG to Fire DMG and granting 25 points of Might. The maximum for Momentum is 15.
When consuming Momentum to deal Fire DMG, if Might is above 100 points, 100 points of Might will be automatically consumed to trigger Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron.
Releasing [Basic Attack] will have Ju Fufu exit the spinning state and throw Hu Wei to attack enemies, dealing Fire DMG. When switching to another character, Ju Fufu will remain in the spinning state and attempt to collide with the nearest enemy.
While Ju Fufu is the currently active character, DMG taken during the skill is reduced by 40%, and Anti-Interrupt Level is increased. If not the active character, she becomes Invulnerable.

ex.name: 特殊技：恶虎七式·下山虎
ex.nameEn: Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms - Mountain-Descending Tiger
ex.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方进行旋转斩击后发动下落斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
ex.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Perform a spinning slash forward, followed by a falling slash, dealing Fire DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：恶虎七式改·下山猛虎
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Tiger Seven Forms Alt - Mountain-Descending Savage Tiger
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
挥舞「虎威」向前方进行强力打击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动时获得3点[威势]和80点[威风]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Swing Hu Wei forward for a powerful strike, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 3 points of Momentum and 80 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：恶虎七式·猛虎炸开花
ultimate.nameEn: Ultimate: Tiger Seven Forms - Raging Tiger Explosion
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
使用「虎威」进行两次下落攻击，造成大量火属性伤害；
发动时获得6点[威势]和100点[威风]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Perform two downward attacks with Hu Wei, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Upon activation, gain 6 points of Momentum and 100 points of Might.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：怒决蹯
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
